Type: bench
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Contemporary Metal Bedroom Bench with Cushion, 58"W, Oatmeal
Colors: Oatmeal
Materials: Metal
A great accent piece, this modern upholstered bench will fit just right at the foot of your bed or in an entryway. With a plush ivory tufted cushion and oiled bronze metal legs, its open, airy design adds seating without making the room feel crowded. 58"L x 18"W x 19"H Metal and fabric (65% rayon; 35% linen) Simple, transitional design with neutral cushion and metal base Steel base provides sturdy support Assemble in 15-30 minutes; attach seat to base Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty
